repos.name: ag-ui-protocol/ag-ui
repos.description: AG-UI: the Agent-User Interaction Protocol. Bring Agents into Frontend Applications.
repos.one_liner: A standardized protocol for integrating autonomous AI agents directly into frontend user interfaces.
bullets: Built with TypeScript to provide a type-safe bridge between agent logic and UI components.
Enables real-time agent-user interaction, state synchronization, and event handling.
Designed to standardize how LLM-based agents communicate their intent and status to end-users.
Ideal for developers building agentic workflows that require human-in-the-loop oversight.

repos.name: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
repos.one_liner: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that allows AI agents to control and inspect Chrome DevTools.
bullets: Leverages the Model Context Protocol to bridge LLMs with browser debugging capabilities.
Allows agents to perform DOM inspection, network monitoring, and console execution.
Facilitates automated web testing, scraping, and complex debugging workflows.
Essential infrastructure for building autonomous agents that interact with modern web applications.

repos.name: arjun988/blender-skills
repos.description: 94 specialist Blender skills for Cursor, Claude Code, Kiro & Codex -> MCP-powered production pipeline from blockout to engine export.
repos.one_liner: A comprehensive MCP-powered toolkit for integrating Blender 3D production pipelines with AI coding assistants.
bullets: Utilizes the Model Context Protocol to expose 94 specialized Blender functions to AI models.
Streamlines the transition from 3D blockout to engine-ready assets via automated scripts.
Designed for integration with Cursor, Claude Code, and other agentic development environments.
Reduces manual overhead in complex 3D modeling and rendering workflows.

repos.name: wdcpclover/ai4paper

repos.one_liner: An AI-powered research assistant platform for PDF translation, literature retrieval, and knowledge base management.
bullets: Features a web-based architecture with Zotero 7 integration for seamless academic workflow.
Utilizes LLMs for bilingual PDF translation, paper summarization, and mind-map generation.
Provides real-time access to 240 million research documents with impact factor metrics.
Useful for quantitative researchers and analysts needing to synthesize large volumes of technical literature.

repos.name: martin-olivier/airgorah
repos.one_liner: A high-performance WiFi security auditing tool written in Rust.
bullets: Developed in Rust to ensure memory safety and high-speed packet processing.
Designed for network security professionals to audit wireless infrastructure vulnerabilities.
Provides a modern, efficient alternative to legacy network security auditing suites.
Focuses on low-level network protocol analysis and security assessment.
